sourceType: Official Government of Punjab tourism website
note: Facts extracted below; prose summaries are written in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source.
about: Punjab's 23rd district (declared 2021), the state's only predominantly Muslim-majority town. Known as a symbol of communal harmony — untouched by 1947 Partition violence, attributed to Guru Gobind Singh Ji's blessing after Nawab Sher Mohammed Khan protested the execution of his younger sons in 1705 ('Haa da Naara').

places.name: Shahi Maqbre (Royal Tombs) & Tomb of Haider Sheikh
places.location: Shahi Maqbre near Sirhindi Gate Chowk; Tomb of Haider Sheikh in city centre
places.facts: Royal tombs of the Malerkotla Nawabs including Nawab Sher Mohammed Khan; separately, the tomb of Sufi founder Sheikh Sadr-ud-Din (Haider Sheikh).

places.name: Gurdwara Haa da Nara
places.facts: Built by Sikhs to commemorate Nawab Sher Mohammed Khan's 1705 protest against the execution of Guru Gobind Singh Ji's younger sons.

places.name: Gurdwara Sri Wadda Ghallughara Sahib
places.location: Village Kutba Bahmania, 6km west of Malerkotla
places.facts: Marks the site of the Wadda Ghallughara (Great Massacre) of 5 February 1762, when Ahmad Shah Durrani's forces and Sirhind/Malerkotla forces attacked a column of ~40,000 Sikhs near Kup and Rohira.

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.location: Centre of Malerkotla city, near Mohalla Baradri
places.facts: Built under Nawab Sher Muhammad Khan, expanded under Nawab Sikandar Ali Khan; 5 original domes survive.

places.name: Diwankhana Sheesh Mahal
places.facts: Royal residence of the Nawabs; glasswork done in two stages, post-1857 and c.1909.

places.name: Mubarak Manzil Palace
places.facts: 19th-century European-style palace built under Nawab Ahmad Ali Khan; still owned by the Nawab family.

places.name: Fort Rehmatgarh
places.facts: Built c.1850 by Nawab Rahmat Ali Khan; remnants now under Ministry of Defence land.

places.name: Kuka Smarak (Namdhari Memorial)
places.facts: Commemorates 66 Namdhari (Kuka) freedom fighters executed by cannon in January 1872.
